messages.subject: Blocked: Docker engine service will not start from this shell
messages.body: Docker Desktop's GUI processes are running (com.docker.backend, Docker Desktop.exe, started ~an hour ago) but the underlying Windows service com.docker.service is Stopped and 'docker info' still fails with 'failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine' after repeated bounded waits. Start-Service com.docker.service fails outright with 'Cannot open com.docker.service service on computer .' -- this shell lacks the privilege to start it, and TCP 5433 confirms nothing is listening. Per the task's own instruction I am stopping rather than fighting this or reconfiguring/reinstalling Docker: this needs either an interactive session with elevated rights to restart the Docker Desktop engine, or the owner/you doing it from a session that has that access -- deliverables 2 and 3 (corpus inventory, loopback confirmation) cannot proceed until Postgres is reachable.

messages.subject: Blocked: Docker engine will not start from this shell, Postgres not brought up
messages.body: I could not bring the local Postgres container up: Docker Desktop's GUI is running but the underlying com.docker.service is Stopped, 'docker info' repeatedly fails to reach the engine pipe, Start-Service is refused for lack of privilege in this shell, and TCP 5433 confirms nothing is listening -- so docker compose ps was never runnable against a live engine. Per the task's own instruction I stopped rather than fighting it, reinstalling, or reconfiguring Docker, and already escalated this exact finding to you as a blocker. Deliverables 2 and 3 (corpus inventory, loopback confirmation) are undone and need either an elevated session restarting the Docker engine or you/the owner doing so before this task can proceed.
